label: Teltonika TRB140
description: A tiny industrial 4G gateway: one Gigabit Ethernet port, a micro-USB and RutOS. It is a modem with an Ethernet face - there is no switch and no radio.
notes: Vendor figures (Teltonika wiki and TRB140 datasheet): one Gigabit Ethernet port plus Micro-USB; 4G LTE Cat 4. No Wi-Fi and no switch fabric, so a single eth0 is the whole data path.
